class.name: NetwPredictJointPlan
class.brief_description: One joint island's replay plan: the member states to restore before replay and the per-transition steps to run after.
class.description: A detached result of one joint pass, built by walking the island's members once and never re-consulted afterward. [method valid] is [code]false[/code] whenever the pass itself was refused, such as a non-JOINT owner or a schedule that cannot re-run, and every other member then answers its zero default rather than a real plan. [br][br]A restore is sparse per field: [method restore_has] tells whether a field was captured at all before [method restore_at] reads it, since a joint rebase can restore only the fields a member's own history actually carried. A step is one command run for one member at one transition, and [method step_provenance] says where that command came from: [code]0[/code] coasted forward with no new input, [code]1[/code] substituted from the local predictor, [code]2[/code] relayed from another peer, or [code]3[/code] authored locally. [codeblock] for i in plan.restore_count(): for field in range(field_count): if plan.restore_has(i, field): apply(plan.restore_slot(i), field, plan.restore_at(i, field)) for i in plan.step_count(): run(plan.step_slot(i), plan.step_transition(i), plan.step_command(i)) [/codeblock] A joint plan spans every member of the island in one pass; it carries no per-slot episode of its own.

method.name: floor
method.description: The oldest transition this pass replays from, the minimum of every member's basis, relay floor, and epoch floor. Equal to [method present] when [method heal] is [code]true[/code], since a healing pass discards the incremental replay and jumps straight to the newest transition instead.

method.name: heal
method.description: Whether the computed [method floor] fell behind what any member's retained history still covers, forcing a full resnapshot at [method present] instead of an incremental replay from [method floor].

method.name: present
method.description: The newest transition this pass plans up to, the transition every member's steps replay toward.

method.name: restore_at
method.description: The captured value for [param field] of the restore at [param index], meaningless unless [method restore_has] is [code]true[/code] for the same pair.

method.name: restore_count
method.description: How many member restores this plan carries, the bound for [param index] on every [code]restore_*[/code] accessor.

method.name: restore_has
method.description: Whether the restore at [param index] captured [param field] at all. A restore is sparse, so a field this answers [code]false[/code] for is left untouched rather than cleared.

method.name: restore_slot
method.description: The slot id the restore at [param index] applies to.

method.name: step_command
method.description: The command the step at [param index] runs, shaped according to [method step_provenance].

method.name: step_count
method.description: How many steps this plan carries, the bound for [param index] on every [code]step_*[/code] accessor.

method.name: step_provenance
method.description: Where the command at [param index] came from: [code]0[/code] the member coasted forward with no new input, [code]1[/code] the local predictor substituted a command, [code]2[/code] a peer relayed one, or [code]3[/code] this owner authored one locally.

method.name: step_slot
method.description: The slot id the step at [param index] runs for.

method.name: step_transition
method.description: The transition the step at [param index] runs, between [method floor] and [method present].

method.name: valid
method.description: Whether the joint pass that built this plan actually ran. [code]false[/code] means the owner was not an open island-joint slot on a re-runnable schedule, or the caller passed an invalid [method present], and every other member of this plan then answers its zero default.
